## Human gates

- [ ] No cookie, authorization header, API-session credential, password, private key, or user data is included.
- [ ] Generated/snapshot changes are complete, stable, and traceable to their source command.
- [ ] Workflow, domain, Cloudflare, VPS, credential, or production changes have human approval.
- [ ] No Agent merged, deployed, changed permissions, or approved production.
